pack: DLC2: Animation, street, craft and ugly media

items.t: Stop motion puppets drawn as though photographed. Visible seams, fingerprints in the clay, felt fuzz on the edges.
Cut paper puppet animation. Hinged limbs, visible joints, flat layered scenery.
Sand on a lightbox. Warm glowing ground, figures made of swept grains, edges soft and shifting.
Rotoscoped line over real movement. Wobbling contour lines that never sit still.
Mural on a brick wall. Paint following the mortar lines, scale enormous, the wall's texture through everything.
Paste up poster on a wall. Wheatpaste wrinkles, torn edges, layered over older posters.
Chalk pavement drawing. Slabs and cracks showing through, colours dusty, one corner already smudged.
Traditional sign painting. Enamel on board, brush confident, drop shadow done by hand, gold leaf if it earns it.
Hand painted shop shutter. Bold and fast, spray and brush together, done in one session.
Batik on cloth. Wax resist cracks running through the colour, dye bleeding along the weave.
Painted ceramic tile. Glaze pooling in the recesses, colours softened by the firing, a hairline crack.
Quilt block. Pieced fabric shapes, contrasting prints, visible quilting stitch across the whole surface.
Lino cut greetings card. One colour, folded, slightly off centre on the card.
Enamel pin artwork. Hard metal outlines separating flat colour, a limited palette, no shading at all.
Neon tube drawing on a dark ground, but rendered flat and matte with no glow, just coloured lines.
Early nineties clip art. Stiff generic figures, thick outlines, a palette of sixteen colours.
Drawn in a basic paint program with a mouse. Jagged edges, flood fill, one pixel outlines, wobbly curves.
Dot matrix printout. Coarse dot grid, banding across the image, tractor feed holes at the sides.
Received by fax. High contrast, scan lines, a compression smear through the middle.
Early web graphic. Dithered colours, hard aliased edges, a small canvas blown up.
Teletext blocks. Chunky coloured cells, eight colours, everything approximated by rectangles.
Cross stitch. The whole image built from small x shaped stitches on visible aida cloth.
Scraperboard. White line scratched out of solid black, no greys, texture built from hatching density.
Silhouette paper cutting. Solid black figures against pale ground, all character carried by outline alone.
Cyanotype. White forms on deep blue, soft edged, uneven coating brushed at the borders.
Marbled paper ground with figures drawn over it in one opaque colour.
Wax resist and ink wash. Crayon holding the light areas, ink flooding everywhere else.
Collagraph. Textured plate printed with visible material impressions, cardboard and string edges.
